nodes.label: Karya Architecture
nodes.summary: Karya is the umbrella system for four independent, explicitly invoked Factories:

nodes.label: Skill Catalog
nodes.summary: Karya provides one optional conversational coordination skill plus specialist skills divided into four independent Factories. Users may invoke `$karya` to receive an explained route and continue through approved specialist capabilities without learning the catalog first, or invoke a specialist directly when the route is already known. Research, Marketing, and Project Harness are never implicit prerequisites of MVP construction or of one another.

nodes.label: Factory Handoff Contracts
nodes.summary: The MVP, Research, Marketing, and Project Harness Factories are independent. The handoffs below describe compatible artifacts, not a mandatory global pipeline. A consumer runs only after explicit user invocation or approval; a producer must never trigger it silently. `$karya` may recommend and coordinate an approved handoff, but it does not change this boundary.

nodes.label: Codex and Manus Integration
nodes.summary: Official API behavior last verified: 2026-07-13.

nodes.label: Optional Economic Execution Routing
nodes.summary: Karya can recommend OpenCode when a user explicitly wants to economize Codex limits or execution cost. OpenCode is only an implementation executor. Codex remains the architect, coordinator, fallback, independent validator, and final auditor.

nodes.label: Factory Workflow Map
nodes.summary: When the route is unknown, start with `$karya`. It classifies the current objective and artifact state, recommends the smallest route with reasons, and waits for approval before applying specialist skills internally. Direct specialist invocation remains valid when the route is already known.

nodes.label: Karya Method
nodes.summary: This document describes only the MVP Factory. It remains independently runnable: the Research Factory, Marketing Factory, and Project Harness Factory are optional workflows. Users who do not know the appropriate entry point may first invoke `$karya` for an explained recommendation and approval; direct invocation of `product-brief-architect` remains valid.

nodes.label: Karya Routing and Coordination
nodes.summary: `$karya` is the optional conversational front door to the Karya catalog. A user describes the desired outcome once; Karya inspects the prompt and relevant project state, recommends the smallest suitable route, explains the decision, obtains approval, and then applies specialist skills internally while remaining the user-facing coordinator.

nodes.label: OpenCode for Backend Execution
nodes.summary: Codex remains the Karya orchestrator. It creates or validates the Goal, requires an approved backend contract, invokes the router once, waits passively, and resumes only when OpenCode exits successfully or with an error. OpenCode performs the heavy Django code-writing phase using `django-backend-code-executor`. Codex then sends the result to `django-backend-service-architect` for contract audit.

nodes.label: Project Generation Flow
nodes.summary: This is the standalone MVP generation flow. Research and marketing may consume or contribute artifacts through explicit handoffs, but they are never implicit generation stages.

nodes.label: Research Harness Adoption Record
nodes.summary: The separate `research-harness` repository was reviewed as a methodological reference for Karya's Research Factory. Its strongest contribution is an adversarial validation loop that distinguishes sourced evidence from interpretation and deliberately constructs both rejection and opportunity cases.

nodes.label: Skill Sequences
nodes.summary: There is no mandatory global sequence. When the correct route is unclear, `$karya` classifies the immediate objective, recommends one primary route, explains why, and waits for approval. It then remains the conversational coordinator while approved specialist skills work internally. Users may still invoke any specialist directly when the route is already known.

nodes.label: Stack Standard

nodes.label: karya
nodes.summary: Karya Coordination. Act as Karya's conversational front door by understanding a user's objective and project context, classifying the immediate need, recommending the smallest suitable Factory, specialist skill, or direct-execution route, explaining why, and waiting for approval before applying specialist capabilities internally. Entrada: skills/karya/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: product-brief-architect
nodes.summary: MVP Factory. Transform a rough product idea, PRD, client notes, market problem, feature list, or screen list into an executable product contract for direct frontend and backend implementation. Entrada: skills/product-brief-architect/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: karya-frontend-builder
nodes.summary: MVP Factory. Build complete frontend applications directly from a product contract, PRD, screen specification, client notes, or sufficiently defined product idea. Entrada: skills/karya-frontend-builder/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: django-backend-service-architect
nodes.summary: MVP Factory. Plan and audit API-first Django backends from executable product, frontend, and API contracts using scalable per-domain Model, Configuration, DTO, explicit Mapper, Controller, Service, and Repository packages. Entrada: skills/django-backend-service-architect/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: karya-backend-router
nodes.summary: MVP Factory. Route an explicitly approved Django backend implementation to OpenCode Go when the CLI, OpenCode Go authentication, and configured coding model are available, otherwise continue with Codex using the same executor-neutral contract. Entrada: skills/karya-backend-router/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: django-backend-code-executor
nodes.summary: MVP Factory. Implement an approved Django backend contract using scalable per-domain Model, Configuration, DTO, explicit Mapper, Controller, Service, and Repository packages. Entrada: skills/django-backend-code-executor/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: karya-infra-orchestrator
nodes.summary: MVP Factory. Use this skill when creating or normalizing Karya infrastructure for a monorepo with frontend, backend, Docker, Docker Compose, Terraform, Render, Supabase and Vercel. It creates local container orchestration, provider-scoped Terraform for declarative cloud infrastructure, frontend/backend Dockerfiles, environment contracts, deployment guidance and validation commands. Do not use this skill for frontend UI refactors or backend business logic.. Entrada: skills/karya-infra-orchestrator/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: market-research-architect
nodes.summary: Research Factory. Turn a product idea, PRD, app concept, market question, or existing product into an executable market-research contract. Entrada: skills/market-research-architect/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: karya-research-router
nodes.summary: Research Factory. Route an approved market-research contract to Codex, AppStoreTracker, Apple, OpenAlex, optional Perplexity, or Manus according to evidence type, authentication needs, cost, and source quality. Entrada: skills/karya-research-router/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: app-market-intelligence-analyst
nodes.summary: Research Factory. Analyze the iOS market for a specific app, developer portfolio, family of apps, category, or comparable cohort using AppStoreTracker and corroborating Apple evidence. Entrada: skills/app-market-intelligence-analyst/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: manus-platform-researcher
nodes.summary: Research Factory. Execute a bounded, read-only research brief inside authenticated or platform-native environments such as Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, communities, directories, or creator marketplaces. Entrada: skills/manus-platform-researcher/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: market-validation-harness
nodes.summary: Research Factory. Challenge a market hypothesis with a provider-neutral, adversarial evidence review and produce an auditable proceed, experiment, revise, pause, or reject decision. Entrada: skills/market-validation-harness/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: commercial-launch-architect
nodes.summary: Marketing Factory. Turn an existing app, platform, service, product brief, or validated idea into an executable commercial launch contract. Entrada: skills/commercial-launch-architect/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: marketing-creative-builder
nodes.summary: Marketing Factory. Build a channel-ready marketing creative pack from an approved launch contract, brand inputs, product evidence, and available screenshots or assets. Entrada: skills/marketing-creative-builder/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: karya-commercial-router
nodes.summary: Marketing Factory. Route an approved commercial task between Codex, Manus, and mandatory human gates while minimizing paid Manus credits. Entrada: skills/karya-commercial-router/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: manus-commercial-operator
nodes.summary: Marketing Factory. Execute an explicitly approved, bounded commercial action through a connected platform in Manus and return a verifiable receipt. Entrada: skills/manus-commercial-operator/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: commercial-validation-analyst
nodes.summary: Marketing Factory. Evaluate a launch or acquisition experiment from an approved commercial contract, execution receipts, funnel metrics, costs, and qualitative feedback. Entrada: skills/commercial-validation-analyst/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: project-harness-architect
nodes.summary: Project Harness Factory. Audit and prepare a new or existing project to work durably with AI through sources of truth, domain-appropriate documentation, AGENTS.md, Codex context, local skills, Specs, runtime policy, thread policy, validation, evidence, and audit. Entrada: skills/project-harness-architect/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: project-spec-architect
nodes.summary: Project Harness Factory. Design or refine an executable project change Spec with a human-readable SPEC.md and a resolved machine-readable SPEC.execution.json. Entrada: skills/project-spec-architect/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: project-skill-author
nodes.summary: Project Harness Factory. Create or update a project-local skill from a stable, specialized, recurring capability with clear triggers, context, invariants, references, workflow, and validation. Entrada: skills/project-skill-author/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: codex-runtime-router
nodes.summary: Project Harness Factory. Validate and execute an already resolved Project Harness Spec through the Codex SDK using its materialized implementation runtime, derived review runtime, durable lifecycle, baseline, validation, and evidence contracts. Entrada: skills/codex-runtime-router/SKILL.md.

nodes.label: karya-execution-router
nodes.summary: Project Harness Factory. Route an explicitly approved, READY, executor-neutral project implementation to OpenCode as an optional economic executor or return Codex fallback, while preserving project contracts, blocked actions, one final signal, independent validation, and Codex audit. Entrada: skills/karya-execution-router/SKILL.md. Projetos com mapa vivo usam Codex fallback antes de acessar o provedor, preservando a proteção de .codex.

nodes.label: project-harness-auditor
nodes.summary: Project Harness Factory. Audit a project's durable AI operating harness by reconciling documentation, decisions, AGENTS.md, Specs, local skills, runtime policy, thread state, completion evidence, validation, and implementation reality. Entrada: skills/project-harness-auditor/SKILL.md.

areas.label: Coordenação Karya
areas.rationale: Coordenação opcional e suas referências de roteamento. O catálogo mantém a invocação direta; esta área não é uma Factory.

areas.label: MVP Factory
areas.rationale: Skills de produto, frontend, Django e infraestrutura; contratos e starters especializados usados no fluxo MVP.

areas.label: Research Factory
areas.rationale: Skills, contratos, workflow e registro de adoção de pesquisa e validação de mercado.

areas.label: Marketing Factory
areas.rationale: Skills, contratos e workflow de lançamento, operação comercial e validação.

areas.label: Project Harness Factory
areas.rationale: Capacidades distribuídas de contexto, Specs, runtime, execução e auditoria; seus contratos, código e testes.

areas.label: Recursos compartilhados
areas.rationale: Recursos transversais e suporte da própria Karya: catálogo, documentação comum, site, marca, exemplos, instalação e contexto operacional local. O kit local do mapa é adoção pela própria Karya; o kit distribuído pertence ao Harness.
